zone.description: The tailnet side of the edge, and the only route to sshd: the default zone is drop, so a login that is not arriving over tailscale0 is refused before it reaches a listener. 22 is the operator's shell and the only port here: nothing on this box answers an inbound deploy any more (design #1010). The public names need no port here: Caddy serves them on the public zone and reaches smortress through the tailnet as a client, which firewalld does not filter. ICMP is not inverted here, so the tailnet keeps ping and PMTU diagnosis.
